summary: Removed: the tree's wrong father for Jerusha Topping.
bio:
Daniel Sayre's 1707 will names 'Hannah Topping the wife of Mr Josiah Topping'.

Banta's Sayre Family ([R4-S1]) calls him Capt. Josiah Topping, born 1663, died 1726, husband of Hannah Sayre, with sons Josiah and John (b. 1706); there is no daughter Jerusha, confirming the earlier removal of this couple from John's direct line. Howell ([R4-S2]) lists Capt. Thomas Topping's children as Elnathan (1640), James, John (1646), Thomas, Mary and Martha, but does not assign Josiah to any of them. If he was a son of John Topping and grandson of Capt. Thomas, he would still be a collateral blood cousin (1C11R), but that link is unproven.
sources: [R4-S1] T. M. Banta, Sayre Family (1901) (archive.org full text), p. 30 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/sayrefamilylinea00bant
[R4-S2] George R. Howell, Early History of Southampton, L.I. (1887) (archive.org full text), pp. 395-396 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/earlyhistoryofso00howe
